difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for a quasi-compact and separated morphism f : X -> Y of algebraic spaces over S, universal closedness, the existence part of the valuative criterion in the sense of this chapter, and the same criterion in the sense of schemes are equivalent (source lines 8927-8948). The proof derives the equivalence of (2) and (3) from the separatedness hypothesis via the comparison lemma for separated morphisms, and the equivalence of (3) and (1) from the characterization of universally closed quasi-separated morphisms by the existence part.
